plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs to reduce risk.
Cut QQQI to a more conservative allocation.
Focus on capital preservation and lower volatility.
This plan prioritizes safety over aggressive growth.
Expect a lower target return with reduced drawdown potential.
conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged positions and holding a larger cash buffer. Expect lower potential gains but also a much lower chance of significant losses.

moves.note: Add inverse ETF for risk management

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs and some concentrated tech holdings.
Reduce QQQI allocation slightly.
Add TZA to hedge against broad market downturns.
This plan balances growth with risk reduction.
Aiming for steady growth with controlled drawdowns.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% per month by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a hedging instrument. It seeks risk-first growth, blending broad market exposure with quality tech and some managed leverage. Expect moderate returns with controlled risk.

moves.note: Add inverse ETF for risk management

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs and AI/Software.
Trim QQQI to fund aggressive additions.
Add TZA to manage potential downside risk.
This plan aggressively pursues growth through concentration and leverage.
Expect higher potential returns but also significantly larger drawdowns.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for high growth, targeting around 4% per month by concentrating in high-conviction leveraged ETFs and tech sectors. It accepts higher risk, including larger potential drawdowns and the daily rebalancing decay of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Eliminate all leveraged and high-beta single names.
Significantly increase allocation to QQQI for income.
Focus on generating steady monthly distributions.
This plan prioritizes reliable income and capital preservation.
Expect lower growth but a more stable, income-focused portfolio.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% per month by prioritizing income-generating assets like QQQI and reducing volatile holdings. It aims for steady monthly distributions and low drawdowns, treating the portfolio more like a cash-generating vehicle. NAV can still fall in market downturns.
